sentences.text: Allongé près du feu, Antoine montre un satellite en orbite qui traverse le ciel.
sentences.en: Lying by the fire, Antoine points out a satellite in orbit crossing the sky.
sentences.ko: 모닥불 옆에 누운 앙투안은 하늘을 가로지르는 궤도 위 인공위성을 가리켜요.

sentences.text: Sarah plaisante en disant que ses amis sont tous en orbite autour du buffet.
sentences.en: Sarah jokes that her friends are all in orbit around the buffet.
sentences.ko: 사라는 친구들이 다 뷔페 주변을 맴돈다고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Antoine observe un faucon qui guette sa proie au-dessus du champ.
sentences.en: Antoine watches a falcon watching for its prey above the field.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 들판 위에서 먹이를 노리는 매를 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Au dîner, Sarah raconte un documentaire où le lion poursuit sa proie dans la savane.
sentences.en: At dinner, Sarah describes a documentary where the lion chases its prey across the savannah.
sentences.ko: 저녁 자리에서 사라는 사자가 초원에서 먹이를 쫓는 다큐멘터리 이야기를 해요.

sentences.text: Antoine règle son niveau à bulle pour monter la tente bien droite.
sentences.en: Antoine adjusts his spirit level to pitch the tent nice and straight.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 텐트를 반듯하게 치려고 수평계를 맞춰요.

sentences.text: Sarah fait une bulle avec son chewing-gum, comme au lycée.
sentences.en: Sarah blows a bubble with her chewing gum, just like in high school.
sentences.ko: 사라는 고등학교 때처럼 껌으로 풍선을 불어요.

sentences.text: Le fermier voisin explique à Antoine que la récolte de blé a été bonne cette année.
sentences.en: The neighbouring farmer tells Antoine that the wheat harvest was good this year.
sentences.ko: 이웃 농부가 앙투안에게 올해 밀 수확이 좋았다고 말해요.

sentences.text: L'ami de Sarah, devenu viticulteur, apporte du vin de sa dernière récolte.
sentences.en: Sarah's friend, now a winegrower, brings wine from his latest harvest.
sentences.ko: 포도 농사꾼이 된 사라의 친구는 지난 수확으로 만든 와인을 가져와요.

sentences.text: Antoine ne mange aucune baie sauvage sans la reconnaître.
sentences.en: Antoine doesn't eat any wild berry without recognising it.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 무엇인지 모르는 산딸기는 절대 먹지 않아요.

sentences.text: Les retrouvailles ont lieu dans une maison qui donne sur la baie, et Sarah adore la vue.
sentences.en: The reunion takes place in a house overlooking the bay, and Sarah loves the view.
sentences.ko: 동창 모임은 만이 내려다보이는 집에서 열리고 사라는 경치에 반해요.

sentences.text: Au bord du lac, Antoine accroche un ver comme appât au bout de sa ligne.
sentences.en: At the lakeside, Antoine hooks a worm onto the end of his line as bait.
sentences.ko: 호숫가에서 앙투안은 낚싯줄 끝에 지렁이를 미끼로 달아요.

sentences.text: Sarah soupçonne que le dessert gratuit était un appât pour les faire rester.
sentences.en: Sarah suspects the free dessert was bait to make them stay.
sentences.ko: 사라는 공짜 디저트가 자기들을 붙잡아 두려는 미끼였다고 의심해요.

sentences.text: Demain matin, Antoine veut grimper au sommet du mont avant le lever du soleil.
sentences.en: Tomorrow morning, Antoine wants to climb to the top of the mountain before sunrise.
sentences.ko: 내일 아침 앙투안은 해 뜨기 전에 산꼭대기에 오르고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Sarah et ses amis se souviennent de leur voyage au mont Saint-Michel.
sentences.en: Sarah and her friends remember their trip to Mont Saint-Michel.
sentences.ko: 사라와 친구들은 몽생미셸 여행을 추억해요.

sentences.text: Sur la route du camping, Antoine doit s'arrêter pour laisser passer le bétail.
sentences.en: On the way to the campsite, Antoine has to stop to let the cattle pass.
sentences.ko: 캠핑장 가는 길에 앙투안은 가축이 지나가도록 멈춰야 해요.

sentences.text: L'ancien camarade de Sarah élève maintenant du bétail en montagne.
sentences.en: Sarah's former classmate now raises livestock in the mountains.
sentences.ko: 사라의 옛 동창은 이제 산에서 가축을 길러요.

sentences.text: Antoine a emmené son chiot, qui découvre la forêt pour la première fois.
sentences.en: Antoine has brought his puppy, who is discovering the forest for the first time.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 강아지를 데려왔는데 강아지는 숲을 처음 구경해요.

sentences.text: Sarah montre à tout le monde des photos de son nouveau chiot.
sentences.en: Sarah shows everyone photos of her new puppy.
sentences.ko: 사라는 모두에게 새 강아지 사진을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Quand l'orage éclate, Antoine se réfugie dans une vieille grange.
sentences.en: When the storm breaks, Antoine takes shelter in an old barn.
sentences.ko: 폭풍우가 몰아치자 앙투안은 오래된 헛간으로 피해요.

sentences.text: La fête a lieu dans une grange rénovée à la campagne, et Sarah arrive la première.
sentences.en: The party is held in a renovated barn in the countryside, and Sarah arrives first.
sentences.ko: 파티는 시골의 리모델링한 헛간에서 열리고 사라가 제일 먼저 도착해요.

sentences.text: Antoine photographie un phénomène rare : un arc-en-ciel au clair de lune.
sentences.en: Antoine photographs a rare phenomenon: a moonlit rainbow.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 드문 현상인 달빛 무지개를 사진으로 찍어요.

sentences.text: Le fou rire de Sarah est un phénomène que personne n'a oublié.
sentences.en: Sarah's fits of giggles are a phenomenon nobody has forgotten.
sentences.ko: 사라의 웃음보는 아무도 잊지 못한 전설이에요.

sentences.text: Près de la ferme, Antoine sent une forte odeur de fumier.
sentences.en: Near the farm, Antoine smells a strong odour of manure.
sentences.ko: 농장 근처에서 앙투안은 거름 냄새를 진하게 맡아요.

sentences.text: L'ami agriculteur raconte à Sarah qu'il utilise le fumier de ses vaches dans les champs.
sentences.en: Her farmer friend tells Sarah he uses his cows' manure on the fields.
sentences.ko: 농부 친구는 소똥 거름을 밭에 쓴다고 사라에게 이야기해요.

sentences.text: Antoine vérifie que son chien n'a pas attrapé de parasite dans les hautes herbes.
sentences.en: Antoine checks that his dog hasn't picked up a parasite in the long grass.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 개가 풀숲에서 기생충을 옮아 오지 않았는지 확인해요.

sentences.text: Sarah apprend que son amie biologiste étudie un parasite des abeilles.
sentences.en: Sarah learns that her biologist friend studies a bee parasite.
sentences.ko: 사라는 생물학자 친구가 꿀벌 기생충을 연구한다는 걸 알게 돼요.

sentences.text: Antoine aperçoit une femelle cerf et ses petits à la lisière du bois.
sentences.en: Antoine spots a female deer and her young at the edge of the woods.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 숲 가장자리에서 암사슴과 새끼들을 발견해요.

sentences.text: La chienne de Sarah est une femelle très calme qui dort sous la table.
sentences.en: Sarah's dog is a very calm female who sleeps under the table.
sentences.ko: 사라의 개는 테이블 밑에서 자는 아주 얌전한 암컷이에요.

sentences.text: Le matin, le sol est si humide qu'Antoine a les pieds mouillés.
sentences.en: In the morning, the ground is so damp that Antoine's feet get wet.
sentences.ko: 아침에 땅이 너무 축축해서 앙투안의 발이 젖어요.

sentences.text: Il fait chaud et humide, alors Sarah propose de dîner sur la terrasse.
sentences.en: It's hot and humid, so Sarah suggests having dinner on the terrace.
sentences.ko: 덥고 습해서 사라는 테라스에서 저녁을 먹자고 해요.

sentences.text: Antoine aide le fermier à semer des radis dans le potager.
sentences.en: Antoine helps the farmer sow radishes in the vegetable garden.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 농부가 텃밭에 무 씨를 뿌리는 걸 도와요.

sentences.text: En partant, Sarah oublie toujours ses affaires ; elle a dû semer son écharpe quelque part.
sentences.en: When leaving, Sarah always forgets things; she must have dropped her scarf somewhere.
sentences.ko: 사라는 떠날 때마다 물건을 잊어버려요. 목도리를 어딘가에 흘린 게 분명해요.

sentences.text: Un troupeau de moutons entoure la tente d'Antoine au réveil.
sentences.en: A flock of sheep surrounds Antoine's tent when he wakes up.
sentences.ko: 잠에서 깨니 양 떼가 앙투안의 텐트를 둘러싸고 있어요.

sentences.text: Sarah et ses amis débarquent en troupeau dans le petit restaurant.
sentences.en: Sarah and her friends pile into the little restaurant like a herd.
sentences.ko: 사라와 친구들이 우르르 작은 식당으로 몰려가요.

sentences.text: Antoine regarde la vapeur monter de sa casserole de café.
sentences.en: Antoine watches the steam rise from his pot of coffee.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 커피 냄비에서 김이 피어오르는 걸 바라봐요.

sentences.text: Sarah fait cuire les légumes à la vapeur pour son amie végétarienne.
sentences.en: Sarah steams the vegetables for her vegetarian friend.
sentences.ko: 사라는 채식하는 친구를 위해 채소를 쪄요.

sentences.text: La foudre tombe sur un arbre au loin, et Antoine compte les secondes avant le tonnerre.
sentences.en: Lightning strikes a tree in the distance, and Antoine counts the seconds before the thunder.
sentences.ko: 멀리 나무에 벼락이 떨어지고 앙투안은 천둥이 칠 때까지 초를 세요.

sentences.text: Entre Sarah et Karim, ça a été le coup de foudre à vingt ans.
sentences.en: Between Sarah and Karim, it was love at first sight at twenty.
sentences.ko: 사라와 카림은 스무 살에 첫눈에 반했어요.

sentences.text: Cette nuit, il risque de geler, alors Antoine sort son duvet le plus chaud.
sentences.en: Tonight it might freeze, so Antoine gets out his warmest sleeping bag.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 얼 수도 있어서 앙투안은 가장 따뜻한 침낭을 꺼내요.

sentences.text: Sarah plaisante en disant que le champagne va geler si on le laisse encore au congélateur.
sentences.en: Sarah jokes that the champagne will freeze if it stays in the freezer any longer.
sentences.ko: 사라는 샴페인을 냉동실에 더 두면 얼어 버릴 거라고 농담해요.

sentences.text: Antoine plante sa tente au milieu d'un pré plein de fleurs.
sentences.en: Antoine pitches his tent in the middle of a meadow full of flowers.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 꽃이 가득한 풀밭 한가운데에 텐트를 쳐요.

sentences.text: Après le repas, Sarah et ses amis vont s'allonger dans le pré derrière la maison.
sentences.en: After the meal, Sarah and her friends go to lie down in the meadow behind the house.
sentences.ko: 식사 후 사라와 친구들은 집 뒤 풀밭에 누우러 가요.

sentences.text: Antoine préfère les vêtements en fibre de laine pour la randonnée.
sentences.en: Antoine prefers clothes made of wool fibre for hiking.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 등산할 때 양모 섬유 옷을 더 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Sarah dit en riant qu'elle n'a pas la fibre maternelle, mais elle adore les enfants de ses amis.
sentences.en: Sarah says laughing that she has no maternal streak, but she adores her friends' children.
sentences.ko: 사라는 웃으며 자기는 모성애 체질이 아니라고 하지만 친구들 아이들은 무척 예뻐해요.

sentences.text: Sur un tronc, Antoine remarque la trace d'une griffe d'ours.
sentences.en: On a tree trunk, Antoine notices the mark of a bear's claw.
sentences.ko: 나무 기둥에서 앙투안은 곰 발톱 자국을 발견해요.

sentences.text: Le chat de la maison laisse une marque de griffe sur la robe de Sarah.
sentences.en: The house cat leaves a claw mark on Sarah's dress.
sentences.ko: 집고양이가 사라의 원피스에 발톱 자국을 남겨요.

sentences.text: Le garde forestier montre à Antoine un petit organisme qui vit sous les pierres.
sentences.en: The forest ranger shows Antoine a tiny organism that lives under stones.
sentences.ko: 산림 감시원이 앙투안에게 돌 밑에 사는 작은 생물을 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: L'ami de Sarah travaille maintenant pour un organisme de protection de la nature.
sentences.en: Sarah's friend now works for a nature conservation organisation.
sentences.ko: 사라의 친구는 이제 자연 보호 단체에서 일해요.

sentences.text: Loin de la ville, le ciel étoilé paraît incroyablement lumineux à Antoine.
sentences.en: Far from the city, the starry sky looks incredibly bright to Antoine.
sentences.ko: 도시에서 멀리 떨어지니 앙투안에게 별이 가득한 하늘이 놀랍도록 밝아 보여요.

sentences.text: Sarah a choisi une salle lumineuse avec de grandes fenêtres.
sentences.en: Sarah chose a bright room with large windows.
sentences.ko: 사라는 큰 창문이 있는 밝은 방을 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Ramasser le bois mort est un travail ingrat, mais Antoine s'en charge.
sentences.en: Collecting dead wood is a thankless job, but Antoine takes it on.
sentences.ko: 마른 나무를 줍는 건 생색 안 나는 일이지만 앙투안이 맡아요.

sentences.text: Organiser ces retrouvailles est un rôle un peu ingrat, mais Sarah aime ça.
sentences.en: Organising this reunion is a somewhat thankless role, but Sarah enjoys it.
sentences.ko: 이 모임을 준비하는 건 좀 생색 안 나는 일이지만 사라는 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Antoine a parcouru une distance respectable avec son sac de vingt kilos.
sentences.en: Antoine covered a respectable distance with his twenty-kilo pack.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 이십 킬로그램짜리 배낭을 메고 꽤 먼 거리를 걸었어요.

sentences.text: L'ancien rebelle de la classe est devenu un notaire très respectable, ce qui amuse Sarah.
sentences.en: The class's former rebel has become a very respectable notary, which amuses Sarah.
sentences.ko: 반의 옛 말썽꾸러기가 아주 점잖은 공증인이 돼서 사라는 웃음이 나요.

sentences.text: Allumer un feu sous la pluie, pour Antoine, c'est un véritable exploit.
sentences.en: Lighting a fire in the rain is a real feat for Antoine.
sentences.ko: 비 속에서 불을 피우는 건 앙투안에게 대단한 일이에요.

sentences.text: Réunir vingt personnes le même soir, c'est un exploit pour Sarah.
sentences.en: Getting twenty people together on the same evening is a feat for Sarah.
sentences.ko: 스무 명을 같은 날 저녁에 모으는 건 사라에게 대단한 일이에요.

sentences.text: La vue depuis la falaise est stupéfiante, et Antoine reste sans voix.
sentences.en: The view from the cliff is stunning, and Antoine is left speechless.
sentences.ko: 절벽에서 본 경치가 놀라워서 앙투안은 말을 잃어요.

sentences.text: Sarah trouve stupéfiant que personne n'ait vraiment changé.
sentences.en: Sarah finds it astonishing that nobody has really changed.
sentences.ko: 사라는 아무도 별로 변하지 않은 게 놀라워요.

sentences.text: Pour Antoine, avoir assez d'eau potable est crucial en montagne.
sentences.en: For Antoine, having enough drinking water is crucial in the mountains.
sentences.ko: 앙투안에게 산에서 마실 물을 충분히 챙기는 건 아주 중요해요.

sentences.text: Pour Sarah, le plus crucial est que chacun se sente bienvenu.
sentences.en: For Sarah, the most crucial thing is that everyone feels welcome.
sentences.ko: 사라에게 가장 중요한 건 모두가 환영받는다고 느끼는 거예요.

sentences.text: Les moustiques ont fini par infliger à Antoine une nuit sans sommeil.
sentences.en: The mosquitoes ended up giving Antoine a sleepless night.
sentences.ko: 모기들 때문에 앙투안은 결국 잠 못 드는 밤을 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Sarah refuse d'infliger aux autres son vieux diaporama de vacances.
sentences.en: Sarah refuses to inflict her old holiday slideshow on the others.
sentences.ko: 사라는 옛날 휴가 슬라이드 쇼를 친구들에게 억지로 보여 주지 않기로 해요.

sentences.text: Depuis le train, Antoine regarde défiler les champs de tournesols.
sentences.en: From the train, Antoine watches the sunflower fields go by.
sentences.ko: 기차에서 앙투안은 해바라기밭이 스쳐 지나가는 걸 바라봐요.

sentences.text: Sur l'écran, Sarah fait défiler les photos de classe de l'époque.
sentences.en: On the screen, Sarah scrolls through the class photos from back then.
sentences.ko: 사라는 화면에 그 시절 반 사진을 넘겨 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Une lampe frontale est indispensable pour Antoine quand il fait nuit.
sentences.en: A headlamp is essential for Antoine once it's dark.
sentences.ko: 날이 어두우면 앙투안에게 헤드램프는 꼭 있어야 해요.

sentences.text: Selon Sarah, un bon gâteau est indispensable pour une fête réussie.
sentences.en: According to Sarah, a good cake is essential for a successful party.
sentences.ko: 사라 말로는 성공적인 파티엔 맛있는 케이크가 꼭 있어야 해요.

sentences.text: Dans le brouillard, Antoine a du mal à distinguer le sentier.
sentences.en: In the fog, Antoine has trouble making out the path.
sentences.ko: 안개 속에서 앙투안은 오솔길을 알아보기가 힘들어요.

sentences.text: Sur la vieille photo, Sarah n'arrive pas à distinguer les jumeaux.
sentences.en: In the old photo, Sarah can't tell the twins apart.
sentences.ko: 옛날 사진에서 사라는 쌍둥이를 구별하지 못해요.

sentences.text: La nuit, la forêt prend un air un peu sinistre, et Antoine allume sa lampe.
sentences.en: At night, the forest takes on a slightly sinister look, and Antoine turns on his lamp.
sentences.ko: 밤이 되면 숲이 좀 음산해 보여서 앙투안은 손전등을 켜요.

sentences.text: Le vieux lycée a maintenant un air sinistre, avec ses volets fermés, remarque Sarah.
sentences.en: The old high school now looks grim with its closed shutters, Sarah notes.
sentences.ko: 덧문이 닫힌 옛 고등학교가 이제 음산해 보인다고 사라가 말해요.

sentences.text: Antoine trouve barbare la façon dont certains campeurs laissent leurs déchets.
sentences.en: Antoine finds the way some campers leave their rubbish barbaric.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 몇몇 캠핑객이 쓰레기를 버리고 가는 게 야만적이라고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Sarah raconte en riant qu'elle trouvait les cours de latin barbares.
sentences.en: Sarah says laughing that she found Latin lessons barbaric.
sentences.ko: 사라는 웃으며 라틴어 수업이 끔찍했다고 이야기해요.

sentences.text: Avec une boussole, Antoine veut démontrer à son neveu que le nord n'est pas là où il croit.
sentences.en: With a compass, Antoine wants to show his nephew that north isn't where he thinks.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 나침반으로 북쪽이 조카 생각과 다르다는 걸 보여 주고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Avec de vieilles lettres, Sarah veut démontrer qu'elle avait raison sur un pari.
sentences.en: With old letters, Sarah wants to prove she was right about a bet.
sentences.ko: 사라는 옛 편지로 내기에서 자기가 옳았다는 걸 증명하고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Le vent fait claquer la toile de la tente toute la nuit, et Antoine ne dort pas.
sentences.en: The wind makes the tent canvas flap all night, and Antoine doesn't sleep.
sentences.ko: 바람에 텐트 천이 밤새 펄럭거려서 앙투안은 잠을 못 자요.

sentences.text: En arrivant, Sarah entend une porte claquer et des rires dans le couloir.
sentences.en: On arriving, Sarah hears a door slam and laughter in the corridor.
sentences.ko: 도착하자 사라는 문이 쾅 닫히는 소리와 복도의 웃음소리를 들어요.

sentences.text: Antoine jette les fruits gâtés au compost du camping.
sentences.en: Antoine throws the spoiled fruit onto the campsite compost.
sentences.ko: 앙투안은 상한 과일을 캠핑장 퇴비통에 버려요.

sentences.text: Le fils de son amie est un peu gâté, mais Sarah le trouve adorable.
sentences.en: Her friend's son is a bit spoiled, but Sarah finds him adorable.
sentences.ko: 친구 아들은 좀 버릇없지만 사라는 귀엽다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Le soir, Antoine lit un roman historique sur une bataille sanglante dans ces collines.
sentences.en: In the evening, Antoine reads a historical novel about a bloody battle in these hills.
sentences.ko: 저녁에 앙투안은 이 언덕에서 벌어진 피비린내 나는 전투를 다룬 역사 소설을 읽어요.

sentences.text: Les amis de Sarah parlent d'un film sanglant qu'ils avaient vu en cachette.
sentences.en: Sarah's friends talk about a gory film they had watched in secret.
sentences.ko: 사라의 친구들은 몰래 봤던 잔인한 영화 이야기를 해요.
